notablePrerequisites: Llanowar Tribe does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.
